name: smwsprites-any-sprite-generator
title: Any Sprite Generator
description:
A very customizable generator. It allows you to set which sprite to spawn (normal or custom, with support to up to 4 extra bytes for the latter), where in the screen the sprite can spawn and the speed it should spawn with (note that some sprites have hardcoded speeds or don't move).

All the settings are via the .asm file.
